messages:
Maya Chen: Hey @Laura @Sam — quick sync to schedule a 90m Kickstart for Greene Health to cover Dedicated onboarding + data/security checklist. Need to align EU folks.

Laura (Greene Health): Hi Maya — thanks! Week of Apr 12 works but mornings only (CEST).

Priya Singh: Proposed slots: 2026-04-13 09:00 CEST, 2026-04-14 14:00 CEST, 2026-04-15 08:00 CEST. Which works?

Rafael Ortiz: FYI we'll include infra + security. Recommend 90m: 30m setup, 45m hands-on, 15m next steps. :thumbsup:

Sam (Greene Health): 4/13 09:00 CEST works for us. Can we get the prework checklist?

Maya Chen: Yep — prework below. Please run this by your infra team before the session.

```prework
- Create an API key in the Redwood Console (role: integration)
- Share VPC CIDR if you want Private deployment tests
- Upload a small prompt set (10-20 rows CSV) for quality checks
- Confirm two test users with access to the account
```

Priya Singh: I'll own the live demo. @Rafael can you bring the Dedicated runbook + perf checklist?

Rafael Ortiz: On it. Also, flagging a minor renewal risk item — Laura mentioned expected volume growth. If throughput needs spike, we should propose a Dedicated reserve. Marking account health as yellow until we confirm numbers.

Laura (Greene Health): Noted. We also want to cover data retention settings and KMS integration during the session.

Priya Singh: We'll add a short security deep-dive (10m) into the agenda. Agenda draft below.

```agenda
1. Intros & goals (10m)
2. Private onboarding checklist (20m)
3. Hands-on: ingest -> deploy -> smoke test (40m)
4. Security: KMS & network (10m)
5. Next steps, action items & followups (10m)
```

cs-bot: Meeting created: 2026-04-13 09:00 CEST — calendar invites sent to participants.

Maya Chen: Thanks all. @Laura please drop any guest accounts we should pre-create. Otherwise we'll proceed with 4/13 09:00 CEST.

Sam (Greene Health): I'll add two accounts and share the CIDR later today. Also: is there a quick eval script we can run pre-demo to sanity-check responses?

Rafael Ortiz: Yes — quick smoke link: https://redwood.dev/internal/evals/quick-smoke — run it against the API key once it's created.

Laura (Greene Health): Got it, works for us. Looking forward to the session. :smile:
